explication: agtx is a terminal-native kanban and orchestration environment for coding agents. A user creates and organizes project tasks on the TUI board; workflow phases and plugins guide agent selection, while the app provisions worktrees and tmux sessions, hands work to agents, and tracks progress for review and merging. SQLite stores board state. MCP and the optional mobile server provide alternate ways to inspect or operate the board. The README documents additional skills and orchestration features; unsampled wiring is shown only where documented or supported by the tree.
